title: ItemPhysics - Fire Starter Add on
description: Restores the ability of thrown items from Item physics to set nearby blocks on fire.
body:
Restores the classic ItemPhysics feature: fiery items like torches set nearby flammable blocks on fire. Flammability influenced by block hardness.
Configurable burn delay, ignition range, and flammable item/block lists. 
NeoForge addon.
